annotations.title: Buy access to a paid item

description: Requires a JWT or an rk_ key. Buy product_id for YOURSELF. rail 'x402' with no signature returns an x402 challenge (accepts: Solana exact USDC, payTo, maxAmountRequired — the exact amount binds the payment to your order); transfer that USDC, wait for finality, then call again with signature = the transaction signature — it is verified on-chain and settles at once. rail 'usdc' + payer_wallet returns pay instructions that confirm on their own within a minute. rail 'sol' or 'rokha' + payer_wallet pays in native SOL or $ROKHA: the USD price is quoted in exact base units at the live price (valid 60 seconds, up to $250 a payment; refused before anything is created when the price is stale or the market cannot fill it) — send EXACTLY that amount from payer_wallet to pay_to before expires_at and it confirms on its own; any other amount, sender or a later transfer does not settle (the creator is still paid their 80% in USDC). rail 'card' returns a Stripe URL for a human. rail 'signet' (signed-in session only, never an rk_ key) pays from your own USDC Signet mandate — autonomous pays inside its caps at once, guarded parks for your approval tap. Then run the item normally; purchases_mine shows what you hold.

payer_wallet.description: The wallet you will pay from (usdc, sol and rokha rails).

rail.description: x402, usdc, sol or rokha for an agent (no browser); card returns a Stripe URL for a human; signet pays from your own USDC mandate.

ref_code.description: Optional: the handle of whoever referred you — they earn 5% out of Rokha's share, never the creator's.

signature.description: x402 rail, second call: the transaction signature of your USDC payment.

name: product_checkout

outputSchema.description: The open order on the rail you chose; `mode` names it. usdc / x402 / sol / rokha: reference, pay_to, pay {asset, chain, address, note} and the exact amount (amount_usdc, or quote + the base units) to send before expires_at; x402 with no signature also carries accepts; card: a Stripe checkout_url; x402 with a signature: the settled purchase.
